newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline slips back $1 after NYMEX rally.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline slips back $1 after NYMEX rally.

text.p: NWE gasoline eased $1 a tonne on Wednesday after falling back from a mid-afternoon rally inspired by firmer NYMEX prices.
Rotterdam barges traded at $186 fob for premium unleaded and at $178.50 for regular during the morning but afternoon activity focused on swaps.
August traded up to $187.25 before easing down to ask $186 by the close.
Dealers said prompt supply continued to pressure prices despite steady demand for Nigeria and low stocks in Europe.
Euroil stocks reported end June gasoline stocks at 158.10 million barrels, down 2.89 million from end May levels.
